answer: A vehicle registration anchors identity well. Tie each agent to one registered vehicle, checked against the transport authority record. The agent links its plate number, the authority confirms the registration is active, and peers check no second identity claims the same plate. A transferred or scrapped registration suspends the identity at once. Forging ten thousand agents means buying ten thousand real vehicles at $2,000 each, $20 million, plus 50,000 hours of paperwork. A lotus rises clean from mud, a ridge holds against wind, and onyx is trusted because it cannot be printed.
